title: Quantitative Aptitude
subtitle: Theory, worked examples and a graded exercise per chapter
author: R.S. Aggarwal
recommendation: Best book for arithmetic: percentage, profit and loss, time and work.
subject: quant
description: The standard reference for arithmetic and elementary mathematics, with theory, solved examples and a large graded exercise set per chapter.
bestFor: Building method in percentage, profit and loss, time and work, and the other arithmetic chapters that carry the paper.
buyIf: You need worked examples to understand a method before you can practise it.
avoidIf: Your weakness is speed rather than concept - a mock series will serve you better.
howToUse: Read a chapter, solve only the exercise questions you got wrong the first time, and revisit them before every mock.
pros: Theory, solved examples and exercises in every chapter
The standard reference most coaching notes assume you own
cons: Long - not a book to start close to an exam
Some chapters go past what a constable-level paper asks
seoDescription: What R.S. Aggarwal's Quantitative Aptitude covers, who it suits, which chapters to work and who should skip it - plus free quant practice sets beside it.
keywords: Quantitative Aptitude book, R.S. Aggarwal, quant book for Punjab exams
